desc: Parse input: N, M, A, B and the M sorted disjoint bad intervals.
Design interval-based reachability sweep with analytic fixpoint expansion (contiguity justified by steps covering all integers in [A, B]).
Derive crossing condition (h + B > R) and new reachable interval [max(R+1, lo+A), h+B] after each bad interval.
Derive final reachability check for N and M = 0 edge case.
Implement final Python solution with stdin/stdout, O(M) complexity, mentally verified against the three samples.
